events.content:
Fixed. `app/product/page.tsx` was awaiting `getInventory()` before rendering the title. I moved the inventory fetch into a `Suspense`-wrapped `InventoryDetails` async component, so the `<h1>` renders immediately while the stock/price stream in.

Build passes and `/product` now shows as partial prerender with dynamic streaming.

part.text:
Fixed. `app/product/page.tsx` was awaiting `getInventory()` before rendering the title. I moved the inventory fetch into a `Suspense`-wrapped `InventoryDetails` async component, so the `<h1>` renders immediately while the stock/price stream in.

Build passes and `/product` now shows as partial prerender with dynamic streaming.
